drive.title: RAFAELIA — ChatGPT Bootstrap Federado — GitHub Drive V1

failure_mode: Cross-store semantic mirror is observed, but byte/hash/revision equivalence is not evidenced by a common digest receipt.
evidence_for: GitHub main commit 48afd905e0dde1539aaabfe7731412fb38d65183 adds the canonical federated ChatGPT bootstrap.
Google Drive document 1__kkzcgJhPPXll_8v6Fm5BnnL2XccDIza-8YX26KJ3g exposes the same title, policy, routing rule, canonical pointers and authority model during this cycle.
Both representations preserve APPEND_ONLY/APENDING, PROVENANCE_FIRST, TOKEN_VAZIO and claim_allowed=false semantics.

lifecycle.retirement_revalidation_criteria: Any material change to bootstrap pointers, authority model, persistence policy, or Drive/GitHub representation requires revalidation.

actions.detective: Compare GitHub path/commit with Drive document identity/content and capture revision/digest when available.
actions.preventive: Do not infer byte identity from matching semantic content.
actions.precautionary: Keep cross-store equivalence as TOKEN_VAZIO until a common digest/revision receipt exists.
actions.adaptive: Use the new bootstrap as the first routing contract for subsequent RAFAELIA cycles while preserving producer authority.
actions.corrective: None required; no divergence has been demonstrated.
actions.maintenance: Revalidate after any material bootstrap change on either store.
actions.safety_assurance: Verify that future cycles resolve objective→authority→route→evidence→gate before writes.
actions.learning_anti_recurrence: Treat the bootstrap itself as a lifecycle component; semantic mirror != digest-proven mirror.

falsifier: A captured Drive revision/export digest and GitHub blob digest differ for representations asserted to be identical, or a material authority/pointer divergence is observed.
next_probe: Capture Drive revision ID/export digest and GitHub blob/content digest; emit a cross-store parity receipt without replacing either authority.
mitigation: Use semantic alignment only for routing; do not use it as cryptographic identity evidence.
